After deploy, verify GET /api/v1/api-keys/subscribe with Accept: application/json and Accept: text/html, /.well-known/commerce.json, /.well-known/agent.json, /api/v1/catalog, and /api/v1/quote?product_id=nhs_api_starter with live-safe curls.
Verify starter, pro, and scale API-key plans are present, and verify quote amount/checkout metadata without logging checkout URLs.
